subject: Sustained latency & error spikes — remediation and credit request
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@haloai.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@haloai.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sustained latency + 5xx spike impacting inference pipelines

Hi Naomi,

We're seeing a sustained regression on calls routed to the r-infer-v2 pool starting late last night. Across three pods our tail latency (p99) has moved from ~210ms to ~950ms and we're also seeing intermittent 5xx responses that are failing whole batches. This has caused our throughput to drop ~35% and several customer-facing jobs have timeouts.

We've opened support tickets but this feels like a platform-level issue. Halo depends on steady latency for our real-time personalization pipeline — the SLA implications are material. Please escalate and let us know:
- Immediate mitigation plan and ETA for stabilization
- A preliminary calculation for SLA credits or refunds given the service impact
- Whether you have a documented post-incident root cause timeline we can share with our ops team

Attaching sample error logs and a short timeline. We need a response today given ongoing customer impact.

Thanks,
Sarah
Director of Platform Operations
HaloAI

Attachment: error_logs_20260913-14.csv (CSV, 120KB)
Attachment: incident_timeline.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@haloai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained latency + 5xx spike impacting inference pipelines

Sarah — thank you for the heads up and for attaching the logs.

Immediate notes: we've identified a degraded kernel path on a subset of GPUs that handles long-sequence batching; that path is intermittently falling back and triggering higher CPU-side queuing which explains the p99 jump and the 5xx batch failures. Our on-call infra team has started a targeted rollback to the previous kernel and a hotfix for the batching circuit breaker is being staged.

Short plan / timings (working with infra):
- 10:00 PDT: begin canary rollback to 3 nodes; monitor p99 and 5xx rate
- 10:30 PDT: if stable, expand to remaining affected nodes (expected stabilization within 30–60 minutes)
- Post-stabilization: full postmortem and timeline (ETA 48–72 hours)

Provisional credits: based on your reported impact window (2026-09-13 22:40 to ongoing), our standard SLA table suggests a pro-rata credit. I've run a preliminary calc and attached an SLA worksheet (SLA_credit_calc_v1.xlsx). This is provisional pending final RCA and exact traffic slices.

Can we hop on a 30-minute call now at 10:15 to align on the scope and customer impact? My team will include Ben (commercial lead) and Soojin (SRE).

—Naomi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA_credit_calc_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sustained latency + 5xx spike impacting inference pipelines

FYI — forwarding the thread after the call. Quick notes for leadership:
- Infra patch mitigated the immediate regression; customer p99 improved to ~250–300ms after expansion but we saw residual batch failures for a short window (estimated total impacted minutes ~95).
- Halo is requesting an initial credit estimate and wants written confirmation to send to procurement.
- Contract: Monthly committed throughput + standard SLA (Section 4.2) — recommend offering a provisional credit of 20% for the impacted billing period, subject to final RCA. That maps to ~USD 28,000 on their current monthly commit.

Requesting approval to proceed with the 20% provisional credit and to prepare a contract amendment for signature. If leadership wants lower exposure we can negotiate 15% and offer a 6-month operational review.

-Ben
VP, Sales Operations
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sustained latency + 5xx spike impacting inference pipelines

Thanks — important to keep this tight. A few points:
1) We should confirm the impacted windows with Halo's traffic slices before finalizing amounts. If the 95 minutes is accurate a 20% provisional credit seems defensible as a good-faith gesture.
2) Ask legal to prepare a brief amendment that spells out the provisional credit and the postmortem clause (no admission of liability; credits tied to measured impact windows only).
3) If Halo pushes for a larger credit, propose a structured offer: 20% credit + 3 months of extended SLO monitoring (no additional fee) as an alternative to a higher cash credit.

Approve Ben to move forward on drafting the amendment and signature workflow. Loop in Legal (cc) when ready.

—Vivek
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@haloai.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@haloai.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained latency + 5xx spike impacting inference pipelines

Naomi, Ben — thanks for the quick response and for the provisional calc. The impact window looks broadly correct. Procurement has asked for an explicit dollar figure and an expected timeline for the DocuSign amendment. A few asks from our side:
- Please confirm the exact impacted minutes and the method used to calculate the 28k figure
- We'd prefer a cash credit vs. monitoring-only compensation; our finance team needs the refund to reconcile Q3 forecasts
- If the amendment can be turned around within 48 hours we can expedite signature from procurement

We're available for a short call at 10:30 PT today to align if you need to walk through the worksheet.

Sarah
Director of Platform Operations, HaloAI
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@haloai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, procurement@haloai.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained latency + 5xx spike impacting inference pipelines — agreement and next steps

Sarah / Halo procurement team — follow up after today's call and the internal legal review. Summary and next steps: 

What we agreed:
- Root cause: kernel fallback in r-infer-v2 batching path (detailed RCA to follow in 48–72 hours)
- Verified impacted window: 2026-09-13T22:40:00Z to 2026-09-14T00:15:00Z (95 minutes) per combined customer and platform telemetry
- Commercial remediation: Redwood will issue a one-time cash credit equal to 20% of the monthly committed plan (USD 28,000) applied to the September invoice. This is a final commercial settlement for the identified window; does not constitute admission of liability.
- Execution: DocuSign amendment (non-material commercial amendment) provided via link; procurement has confirmed internal sign-off processes.

Deliverables and timing:
- DocuSign amendment sent within 24 hours (link: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ12345)
- Final RCA and postmortem in 72 hours (includes timeline and corrective actions)
- 30-day operational review kickoff (Redwood & Halo) — optional deep-dive into batching/quantization knobs to reduce recurrence risk

Attachments: final SLA math (SLA_credit_calc_v1.xlsx), incident timeline (incident_timeline.pdf)

If this summary matches your expectations, we'll mark the ticket as resolved once the amendment is countersigned and the credit applied. Thanks again for the partnership and for the quick sync earlier.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
